arStrings.szText: {c_important}Shadow Step{/c} has an additional Charge and refunds a Charge when it kills an enemy. Casting {c_important}Shadow Step{/c} increases its damage by {c_number}[SF_36 * 100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}[SF_37]{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}[SF_36 * SF_38 *100|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Shadow Step{/c} {c_important}{u}Dazes{/u}{/c} its primary target for {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_B_DAZE}{/c} seconds and leaves {c_number}{SF_27}{/c} {c_important}{u}Stun Grenades{/u}{/c} at its feet that each deal {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_GRENADES_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.

{c_important}Shadow Step{/c} no longer requires a target, and it leaves a decoy at your starting location that {c_important}Taunts{/c} Nearby enemies and explodes after {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_C_BUFF_FUSE}{/c} seconds, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_PAYLOAD}{/c} Shadow damage.

{c_important}Shadow Step's{/c} Cooldown is increased to {c_number}{SF_40}{/c} seconds.
Damaging an enemy with {c_important}Shadow Step{/c} applies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} to them for {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} seconds.
Casting {c_important}Shadow Step{/c} reduces its Cooldown by {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Shadow Step's{/c} stab now cleaves, dealing {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|%|]{/c} of the original damage to the cleaved targets.
